entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Carlo I Tocco was the hereditary Count Palatine of Cephalonia and Zakynthos from 1376, and ruled as the Despot of Epirus from 1411 until his death on July 4, 1429. As a member of the Tocco family, a powerful noble clan in the Byzantine Empire, Carlo I Tocco played a crucial role in the politics of the region. His tenure as Despot of Epirus saw the rise of the Ottoman Empire's influence in the Balkans, as the Ottomans began to expand their territories beyond Anatolia into the region.
